LANDING.HERO_SUBTITLE: Open a bill, add drinks and nyama choma, take cash or M-Pesa — stock counts itself down and every shilling lands in its own bucket.
LANDING.NIGHT_TITLE: From the first bill to the last
LANDING.STEP1_DESC: Every table or guest gets a numbered bill. An unpaid bill stays open, even into tomorrow.
LANDING.STEP2_DESC: Castle Lite, mshikaki, a portion, ndizi — any quantity. Stock is checked before it sells.
LANDING.STEP3_DESC: Cash, M-Pesa, Tigo, Airtel or bank — or a mix. Change is worked out, a receipt prints.
LANDING.STEP4_DESC: Each sale is split at once between staff, owner, TRA, rent, LUKU and the rest.
LANDING.SPLIT_DESC: Each item carries its own percentage split. Sell a portion and the money for TRA, rent, the loan and the next delivery is set aside before it can be spent.
LANDING.FEATURES_TITLE: Built for a bar, not a shop
LANDING.F1_TITLE: Stock by the crate and the kilo
LANDING.F1_DESC: Beer is bought by the crate and sold by the bottle. Meat is bought by the kilo and sold as mshikaki, portion or half — the system knows what each one takes from the store.
LANDING.F2_DESC: Print the bill before paying, and the full receipt after.
LANDING.F3_DESC: Everyone sees only what they need — waiter, manager or owner.
LANDING.F4_DESC: Sales, stock used and money buckets — by day, week or month.
LANDING.F5_DESC: One account for all your bars, each branch with its own stock.
LANDING.CTA_TITLE: The bar is open. Come in.
LANDING.CTA_SUBTITLE: Pick up where you left off — your open bills are waiting.
LANDING.GALLERY_TITLE: Music, cold beer, nyama choma - and clean books
LANDING.GALLERY_DESC: Customers see the counter, the grill and the fun. Behind it, Midland tracks every bottle, every skewer and every shilling - no ledger books.
LANDING.G_COUNTER_NOTE: Every drink lands on its table's bill
LANDING.G_BEER_NOTE: Bought by the crate, sold by the bottle
LANDING.G_GRILL_NOTE: One kilo - skewers, portions or halves
LANDING.G_COCKTAILS_NOTE: Every service with its own price
LANDING.G_CROWD_NOTE: Bills stay open until they are paid

SETTINGS_PAGE.TITLE: System Settings
SETTINGS_PAGE.PURPOSE_TEXT: The Settings module allows administrators to configure and manage the application's core features, security, users, workflows, and system preferences.
SETTINGS_PAGE.WHAT_YOU_CAN_DO_LIST:
• Manage tenants and organizational information.
• Configure users, roles, and permissions.
• Set up workflows and approval processes.
• Manage notifications and system preferences.
• Configure integrations and other administrative settings.
SETTINGS_PAGE.NOTE_TEXT: Changes made in this section may affect the entire system. Only authorized administrators should modify system settings to ensure security, consistency, and proper application operation.

CONFIGURATION_PAGE.TITLE: System Configuration
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.PURPOSE_TEXT: Configuration Management allows administrators to configure and maintain system-wide settings that control the behavior, security, and operational features of the application.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.WHAT_YOU_CAN_DO_LIST:
• Configure email settings.
• Configure SMS settings.
• Manage notification preferences.
• View and manage audit logs.
• Customize system behavior.
• Save and update configuration settings.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.NOTE_TEXT: Configuration settings affect the entire system. Changes should only be performed by authorized administrators to ensure system stability, security, and consistent operation.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.GENERAL_SUBTITLE: Platform-wide numbers that control billing, sessions and maintenance.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.COMMISSION_RATE_HINT: Share of each subscription payment paid to the staff member who registered the branch. Changing this affects future payments only.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.DIRECTOR_PERCENT_HINT: Share of each month's income due to the director role in total, divided between however many hold it.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.ROOT_PERCENT_HINT: Share of each month's income due to the ROOT role in total, divided between however many hold it.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.TRIAL_DAYS_HINT: How long a newly registered branch can use the system before it must pay.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.GRACE_PERIOD_DAYS_HINT: Extra days a branch can keep logging in after its subscription expires. 0 locks them out immediately.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.MINIMUM_PAYMENT_HINT: Smallest subscription payment that can be collected.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.DEFAULT_PLAN_PRICE_HINT: Pre-filled on every new branch. 0 means no default.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.SESSION_LENGTH_HINT: How long a user stays logged in before signing in again.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.ERROR_RETENTION_HINT: How long an error stays in Settings > Errors.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.ERROR_PURGE_HINT: When cleared errors are removed for good. Must be greater than or equal to the value above.
CONFIGURATION_PAGE.LOW_STOCK_LEVEL_HINT: A service with this many packs or fewer left (crates, cartons - or single units, if it has no pack) is shown in red as running low.

BRANCH_CHOICE.TITLE: Choose a branch
BRANCH_CHOICE.SUBTITLE: You work in more than one branch. Which one are you working in now?

USER_BRANCHES.TITLE: Branches for {{name}}
USER_BRANCHES.SUBTITLE: Tick the other branches this user may work in. They choose one each time they log in.
USER_BRANCHES.TOOLTIP: Branches this user may work in

OTHER_SPLIT.TITLE: Other Expenses - where they go
OTHER_SPLIT.SUBTITLE: The Other share of every sale is split across the things you list here - each gets its own pot to record spending against.
OTHER_SPLIT.EMPTY: Nothing listed yet - Other stays one pot, as it is now.
OTHER_SPLIT.NOTE_FORWARD: It applies to sales from now on; Other already collected stays in the 'Other' pot.
OTHER_SPLIT.NOTE_REPORT: Each item shows in Reports → Other Expense Report: collected, paid out and left, with Pay and Details buttons.
OTHER_SPLIT.NOTE_CLEAR: Remove every item and save, and Other is one pot again.
OTHER_SPLIT.REPORT_NOT_SPLIT: Not split (before the split was set)
OTHER_SPLIT.EXPENSE_DESC: Each item of the Other split: collected, paid out and left - pay from it or see its history here.
OTHER_SPLIT.EMPTY_REPORT_TEXT: Set the split in POS → Setting → Other split, and sales will fill these pots.
OTHER_SPLIT.GROUP_DESC: Total of {{count}} Other items - broken down in the Other Expense Report

CASH_UP.PERIOD: Shift {{from}} - {{to}} · {{bills}} bills you took payment for
CASH_UP.SINCE: Since {{from}} · {{bills}} bills you took payment for
CASH_UP.NOTE_PH: Note (optional) - e.g. reason for a shortage
CASH_UP.CONFIRM: Submit the cash-up? Expected Tshs {{expected}}, counted Tshs {{counted}}. It cannot be changed afterwards.
CASH_UP.CLOSED_OK: Cash-up saved - the count matches (over by Tshs {{amount}}). You can open a new shift.
CASH_UP.CLOSED_SHORT: Cash-up saved - short by Tshs {{amount}}. You can open a new shift.
CASH_UP.HINT: Expected = the payments you took between opening and closing this shift, less the payouts you recorded in the system in it. Count the cash and each method's balance, then enter them here.
CASH_UP.HISTORY_DESC: Each cashier: expected, counted and the difference. Click a row for each method.
CASH_UP.PAYOUTS_DESC: taken by the system from pot payments, staff commission and Stock & Purchase - they cannot be changed here
CASH_UP.PAYOUTS_NONE: You recorded no payouts in this shift.

SHIFT.NONE_TEXT: Open a shift to start selling.
SHIFT.NONE_TEXT_STAFF: Selling is off: the cashier signed in here must open a shift first.
SHIFT.OWN_TO_SELL: To sell yourself, open your own shift.
SHIFT.CLOSE_CONFIRM: Close the shift now? You won't be able to sell until you do its cash-up and open a new shift.
SHIFT.CLOSED_TEXT: Do its cash-up before opening a new shift.
SHIFT.CLOSED_TEXT_STAFF: Selling is off: the cashier's shift is closed - they must do its cash-up and open a new one.
SHIFT.CLOSED_OK: Shift closed - now do its cash-up
SHIFT.LIST_DESC: Who opened each shift, when it was opened and closed, and its cash-up.

STOCK_TAKE.TITLE: Stock count
STOCK_TAKE.SUBTITLE: Count what is on the shelves; the system shows each difference and its value, then corrects the stock.
STOCK_TAKE.NO_ITEMS: No products are counted in the store.
STOCK_TAKE.CONFIRM: Save the count? {{different}} products with a difference will be corrected in stock.
STOCK_TAKE.HINT: Products you do not count are left as they are. Value is at buying price. Use '=' for a product that matches the system.
STOCK_TAKE.VARIANCE_DESC: Counts made and the loss by product for the chosen period.
STOCK_TAKE.EMPTY: No stock count in this period.

SPEND_DIALOG.SUBTITLE: Enter the amount, how it was paid and what it was for.
SPEND_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION_PH: What was this money spent on?

INSIGHTS.TITLE: Profit & Sales
INSIGHTS.SUBTITLE: Each product's profit over its buying price, best sellers, slow movers and peak hours.
INSIGHTS.UNKNOWN_COST_NOTE: Some products (e.g. food) have no buying price, so their profit is unknown and left out of the profit and margin above.
INSIGHTS.SLOW_DESC: Products in stock that sold nothing in this period - money sitting on the shelf.
INSIGHTS.SLOW_NONE: Everything in stock sold in this period.
INSIGHTS.PEAK_EMPTY: No timed sales in this period.
INSIGHTS.PEAK_HINT: Darker = more sales. New sales count at the hour they went on the bill; older ones at the hour the bill was paid.

LEDGER.TITLE: Pot balances since the start
LEDGER.SUBTITLE: Pots are kept per week; here they are all added up - the TRA, rent, salaries money that is really there today.
LEDGER.HINT: Click Other Expenses to see each item. Pay from a pot in Income & Expenses or the Other Expense Report.

BILL_NICKNAME.PH: Customer nickname - only you see it
BILL_NICKNAME.LABEL: Customer nickname (this device only)

BILL_EDIT.TITLE: Take {{name}} off the bill
BILL_EDIT.NOTE: It goes back to the store and comes off the bill, the split and the commission. The removal is recorded with your name.
BILL_EDIT.LIST_DESC: Every item taken off an open bill: who, when, and why.
BILL_EDIT.EMPTY: Nothing taken off bills in this period.

STAFF_LOSS.TITLE: Handover shortage
STAFF_LOSS.EXPECTED_HINT: Filled from their open bills - change it if needed
STAFF_LOSS.NOTE_PH: e.g. says a customer left without paying
STAFF_LOSS.HINT: The shortage comes off what this staff member is owed in commission, and off your expected cash at cash-up.

OFFLINE.OFFLINE_TEXT: No internet - sales go on here and are sent when it is back.
OFFLINE.OTHERS_PENDING: {{n}} more waiting for another user to sign in on this device.
OFFLINE.STAFF_NOT_CACHED: This staff code is not on this device yet - open Sales once online.
OFFLINE.UNLOCK_FAILED: Wrong login - offline, only a manager login that opened Staff Sell online on this device works.
OFFLINE.REASON_REQUIRED: Write why it is being taken off.
OFFLINE.NO_SHORTAGE: Nothing is short - what was handed in covers the bills.
OFFLINE.WAIT_SYNC: Wait until the sales made offline have been sent.
OFFLINE.NOT_CACHED: Not available offline - it has not been opened online on this device yet.
OFFLINE.SHIFT_NEEDS_CASHUP: Do the cash-up of your closed shift (needs the internet) before opening a new one.
OFFLINE.BILL_NOT_FOUND: Bill not found on this device.
OFFLINE.ITEM_NOT_CACHED: That item's price is not on this device yet - open the item list once online.
